integrity_notes: The result is proved analytically; finite computations are cross-checks, not infinite certificates. Angular entropy normalization and all endpoint cases are stated. Originality is conditional on the inspected literature and carries the explicit risk of an implicit reduction from a broader divergence bound.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion applies to stationary entropy production of the angular Poisson-jump subprocess. It does not give total positional path entropy, motor heat, interacting-particle costs or a non-Poisson tumbling theorem. For smooth turning densities with nonzero chirality the sharp value is an unattained infimum; the zero-chirality minimum is achieved by symmetric smooth turning laws. Two-angle laws need not give uniquely ergodic orientation processes.
title: Sharp angular dissipation cost of persistence and chirality in preferred-reorientation run-and-tumble particles
